# Legal
Access Aadhaar legal documents including the Aadhaar Act, 2016, Aadhaar and Other Laws (Amendment) Act, 2019, ordinances and updated regulations related to targeted delivery of subsidies, benefits and services. These documents define the legal framework governing Aadhaar, authentication and related services in India.
